title: Great way for the little ones to get in the Easter spirit!
text: Great way for the little ones to get in the Easter spirit!. These are super cute Easter window decorations. I had my two young grandsons over a couple of weeks ago and the three of us had a lot of fun decorating my window and door glass with these. They apply easily and just as easily they come off (which makes it a great way for my grandsons to change their designs easily. And, when the holiday was over, I easily removed them from my windows. This is a great, inexpensive way to decorate your home. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Mocossmy Easter Window Clings Decorations,9 Sheets Cute Bunny Footprint Happy Easter Egg Gnome Reusable Static Window Stickers for Kids Home Office School Classroom Easter Spring Party Supplies Favors
features: 【Value Package】You will get 9 sheets of colorful Easter glass clings.This Easter party decals are suitable for Easter party, holiday indoor decorations.Look so pretty on the window and are such a little lovely addition to your Easter decorations!Really adds a festive touch!

【Rich Patterns】These lovely window clings are full of Easter elements, well printed with colorful Easter egg,cute bunny and faceless elf,beautiful flowers,etc.You can see it from both sides of the window,easily creating a Easter party touch which kids will love.

【Premium Material】Easter glass clings is made of PVC materials with great water-resistance and durability for reusing, easy to stick and remove without damaging windows.It is non-toxic and non-pungent,children can play with it safely.It can be used for a long time.

【Easy to Use】This Easter window decals are static clings, and can be stuck on windows without glue, just clean the surface of the pasted object before pasting and simply spray a little water on the surface before stick it on window, easy to use and take down, will not scratch your windows.

【Wide Application】Simple but adorable festival decors, making a huge hit for your Easter party decorations.Also adorable gifts for your friends and families.Suitable for glass window, mirror, refrigerator, bathtub, water bottle, marble wall and any other smooth surface.Also great as gift to put in Easter basket.
